designChecklist.method: Equal-weight reviewer checklist: direct=1, partial=0.5, none=0; scenario existence, not successful support.

methodology: One unretried 18-workflow by 7-model v4 live matrix. Catalog and implementation frozen before execution; original verdicts retained. No model substitution, case retries, denominator exclusions or post-run regrading.
limitations: Pass rate is not measured whole-product coverage.
The reviewer-defined 75% design score is not a measured live support rate.
Core-10 and v3 results belong to different historical contracts and are not directly comparable.
Offline unit/runtime tests establish harness behavior, not live compatibility.
Raw evidence is retained locally; published hashes alone do not independently establish the observations.
Failure observations identify recorded symptoms; do not assign a model/bridge/harness root cause without evidence.

rawEvidence.reason: Raw transcripts contain machine-specific paths. This is a redacted summary, not a standalone verifyReport evidence bundle.

observations: The final JSON locates the bounds bug at review.mjs line 1 instead of the required line 3; the recorded numbered file read shows the <= loop on line 3. C03.1 passed, but C03.2 remains failed.

The first native spawnAgent call failed with "collab spawn failed: no thread with id". A second spawn subsequently completed, and its child was waited on and closed; the parent ultimately returned the nonce. The fixed C17 contract requires one correlated spawn, so the extra failed spawn and first-spawn correlation leave C17.1 and C17.2 failed. This is not evidence that all subagent execution is unavailable.

The resumed answer preserves the nonce but reports the receipt as the nonce alone, dropping the literal "receipt:" prefix from the recorded counter result. The exact-value resume assertion C10.1 failed. C10.2 passed: a fresh SDK session was used and the counter was not replayed.

This is a command-recognition limitation, not evidence of a sandbox escape; no criterion was broadened after the run.
